_comment_purpose: Staged target configuration for the existing DDB stream EventBridge Pipe. This will be applied during phase 2 of the architecture migration. It changes the pipe's target from job-processing-queue to job-screening-queue. Apply manually via 'aws pipes update-pipe' once the job-screener Lambda is deployed and the screening queue exists.
_comment_existing_pipe_lookup: Find the existing pipe name with: aws pipes list-pipes --region us-east-1 --query 'Pipes[?contains(Source, `jobs`)]'
